source.provenance: Existing local aerial DWG; producer identity is not authenticated. The pinned LibreDWG JSON agrees on all ten ordered values and the parent/reactor handle targets.

specification.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
specification.use: The section defines the AcDbXrecord data block as RS DXF-group indicators followed by typed values, and describes the body boundary, cloning field and common handle stream.

wireProfile.footer: compressed BS value 1 then cloning bit 0; object body ends at bit 612

commonHandleTail.owner: H(role=8,length=0), relative offset resolves to extension 0x2C3

wireProfile.wireWidths: Groups 460–463 and 464 carry raw 64-bit doubles; groups 290 and 293 carry one raw byte each; groups 270, 272 and 273 carry two-byte integers. Every group indicator and value is compared against both ordered same-import typed lists.

binding.identity: The unique MATERIAL 0x2C2, complete extension dictionary 0x2C3 and XRECORD 0x2C4 are joined to same-import source publications by generation, handle, source location and ordinal. The raw frame must match the captured type/profile, immutable typed baseline, payload-matched status and original publication.
binding.graph: The exact unique ADVMATERIAL key points to 0x2C4; the MATERIAL owns extension 0x2C3, which owns the XRECORD. The six MATERIAL EED and 36 TILE source branches must already qualify.
binding.scope: This binds one source profile for a future explicit DXF compatibility route. It does not establish ADVMATERIAL field semantics, output support or MATERIAL-root closure.

validation.result: PASS. The owning selector binds ADVMATERIAL 0x2C4 in the same import as its source dictionary and MATERIAL.
validation.controls: Header, data-start, payload and owner-link bit mutations reject and recover. Publication-offset, failed-capture, changed typed double, parent-handle and dictionary-target mutations reject and recover. A foreign adapter cannot reuse the proof.
validation.sourceFixture: The selector uses an existing untracked local sample. No DWG or DXF fixture was added.

limits: Only profile 0x2C4 is bound in this slice; the other five compact ADVMATERIAL records and DIFFUSE/BUMP remain open.
Groups 460–464 remain a source-bound compatibility observation. No Autodesk native semantic interpretation has been established.
No DXF write, refusal/retry transaction, or independent readback was performed in this slice.
